L-V0692_Autonomous_Video_QA___Repair_Loo.title: Autonomous Video QA & Repair Loop #12
L-V0692_Autonomous_Video_QA___Repair_Loo.summary: INGESTION + FRAME SAMPLING The rendered video goes in; frames are sampled across the timeline so the critic can see, not guess.
L-V0692_Autonomous_Video_QA___Repair_Loo.pipeline: video-input → reference-image-input → video-analyzer → 5× video-frame-extract → 4× text-gen → 3× image-gen → 3× video-reference → video-concat → text-gen → download
notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion of rendered video → Frame Extraction samples N frames per shot → Quality Critic scores product-fidelity, motion-plausibility, continuity, artifact-freedom per shot → Failure Vector Classifier tags exact defect (warped geometry / lipsync drift / lighting mismatch / morphing artifact) → Targeted Repair regenerates ONLY the failing shot segment via Nano Banana Pro keyframe fix + Omni Flash 1.1 re-animation → Re-splice into master timeline → Re-score → escalate to human review after 2 failed repairs.
STAGE 1 — INGESTION + FRAME SAMPLING The rendered video goes in; frames are sampled across the timeline so the critic can see, not guess.
STAGE 2 — QUALITY CRITIC Scores product-fidelity, motion-plausibility, continuity and artifact-freedom per shot.
STAGE 3 — FAILURE VECTOR CLASSIFIER + ROUTED REPAIR Warped geometry, lipsync drift, lighting mismatch and morphing artifacts each route to their own fix: a corrected keyframe plus a re-animation.
STAGE 4 — RE-SPLICE + RE-SCORE + ESCALATION Repaired shots spliced back into the master timeline and re-scored. Two failed repairs on the same shot escalates to human review.
